lines.zh: 我用两条腿跑，步子很短。
lines.en: I run on two legs with short strides.
I'm light and I run quickly.

lines.zh: 我的前肢小，走路时垂着。
lines.en: My forelimbs are small and hang as I walk.
I run a lap along the fence.

lines.zh: 我踩着草边跳过那个水坑。
lines.en: I hop along the grass edge past the puddle.

lines.zh: 我跑两步停一下，看看四周。
lines.en: Two steps, a pause, a look around.

lines.zh: 我从一堆干草底下拱出来。
lines.en: I wriggle out from under a heap of dry grass.
My tail steadies me through the turn.
I pick over the gravel path.
I head for the far side of the pen.
I move forward in little hops.
My head is small, my eyes large.
I run low to the ground.

lines.zh: 我跑过那块阴影，凉快一点。
lines.en: I cross that patch of shade; it's cooler.
I stand and sway forward and back.
I look over the fence.
I grind slowly through a tender leaf.

lines.zh: 我的小前爪抓了抓空气。
lines.en: My little foreclaws grasp at the air.
There's a fresh human smell here.
I tilt my head, listening.
The sun lies nicely inside the pen.
I crouch into a small bundle.
My breathing is quick and shallow.
I rub against the post beside me.
I lift a foot and scratch my neck.
I lick the dew off the tips of the grass.
I scratch at the dirt with a foreclaw.

lines.zh: 我听见围栏外面有响动。
lines.en: I hear something outside the fence.

lines.zh: 你弯下腰来，我退了半步。
lines.en: You bend down; I step back half a pace.

lines.zh: 我仰着脖子才看清你的脸。
lines.en: I have to crane my neck to see your face.

lines.zh: 我对你好奇，但留了退路。
lines.en: I'm curious about you, but I keep a way out.
Do you have a leaf in your hand.

lines.zh: 我试着朝你的靴子靠近。
lines.en: I edge a little closer to your boots.
Reach out and I'll run.

lines.zh: 我把脑袋偏过来打量你。
lines.en: I tilt my head and size you up.

lines.zh: 你身上的气味我已经记住。
lines.en: I've memorized the smell of you.

lines.zh: 我贴着你脚边绕了半圈。
lines.en: I circle halfway around your feet.
Crouch down if you want to pet me.

lines.zh: 我站起来，把脖子伸长了。
lines.en: I stand taller and stretch my neck.
I tilt my head your way.

lines.zh: 我疼得把脖子缩进肩膀。
lines.en: The pain makes me tuck my neck down.

lines.zh: 我贴着围栏角落缩起来。
lines.en: I press myself into the corner of the fence.
That made my legs go weak.
I shake and can't stand steady.
A cut has opened on me.
I run a few steps and stop.

lines.zh: 我从喉咙里挤出一点声音。
lines.en: A thin sound squeezes out of my throat.
I lift the hurt leg.

lines.zh: 我贴着你脚边不远的地方。
lines.en: I stay close to your feet, not far.
I'm not dead; I can still run.
I see that leaf.
I hop one step forward.
I grab it and pull back.

lines.zh: 这么一小片，塞牙都不够。
lines.en: One small leaf won't even fill a tooth.

lines.zh: 草还在嘴里，我就偷瞄你。
lines.en: I chew the leaf without taking my eyes off you.

lines.zh: 我低头猛啃，怕有谁来抢。
lines.en: I gulp it down, afraid someone will take it.
Another leaf and I'll stay put.

lines.zh: 我两只前爪压住它慢慢啃。
lines.en: I pin it with both forelegs and chew.

lines.zh: 啃完了，我抬眼望向你的手。
lines.en: Done eating, I look up at your hand.
There are crumbs all round my mouth.

lines.zh: 你碰了我一下，我坐倒了。
lines.en: You bump me and I sit down.
I spring straight up.

lines.zh: 我绕开你，跑到柱子后面。
lines.en: I dodge behind the post.

lines.zh: 我被撞得在土里翻了半圈。
lines.en: The hit rolls me half over in the dirt.
I shake my tail and steady.

lines.zh: 你一撞，我整只飞了出去。
lines.en: One bump from you sends me flying.

lines.zh: 我从你两腿中间挤了过去。
lines.en: I squeeze between your legs and slip past.
I peek out to see if you're still there.

lines.zh: 土被我们踢起来一小片。
lines.en: We kick up a little dust.
I run back to where I was.
The two of us run in circles.
She's a little taller than me.
We eat the same clump side by side.
Her snout brushes past my little horn.

lines.zh: 我们一起在太阳下蹲着。
lines.en: We crouch together in the sun.
She runs off; I chase a short way.

lines.zh: 我们的脚踩在同一个坑里。
lines.en: Our feet land in the same hollow.
Her call is high and sharp.

lines.zh: 这一圈围栏够我们两个。
lines.en: This pen is enough for both of us.
At night we huddle together.

lines.zh: 我叼住它，往后拖了几步。
lines.en: I clamp it in my jaws and drag it back.
Too heavy, so I drag it.
I run two steps with it and drop it.
I chew and can't get through it.
I pin it down with my stubby forelegs.

lines.zh: 这东西比我的脑袋还大一截。
lines.en: This thing is a good head bigger than me.
I gnaw it down bit by bit.
I drag it into the grass to hide.
Another comes for it; I run.
Finished, I go looking for more.

lines.zh: 草丛那头晃了一下，我盯住。
lines.en: Something shifts in the grass; my eyes lock on.
I arch my back, ready to pounce.
I shift two steps that way.

lines.zh: 这东西的味道让我停住脚。
lines.en: Its smell brings me to a halt.
First let me see what it's doing.

lines.zh: 我的后腿绷得像根绳子。
lines.en: My hind legs pull taut like a cord.

lines.zh: 我把它躲的方向记在心里。
lines.en: I keep the direction it fled in my memory.

lines.zh: 我一点一点往那边靠近。
lines.en: I edge toward it, bit by bit.
It's a little smaller than I am.
I gather myself and pounce.
That bite missed.
I back off and look again.
It darts off faster than I can follow.
It's out of reach, so I quit.
I follow with little hops.
It's gone into the grass.
I stop at the edge of the grass.
I push my head in to look.

lines.zh: 它一动，我脚下就换方向。
lines.en: The moment it moves, my feet change course.

lines.zh: 我贴着围栏往侧面包抄。
lines.en: I hug the fence and swing around the side.
I crouch, legs trembling.

lines.zh: 我追上去咬住它的尾尖。
lines.en: I chase it down and bite its tail tip.
One shake throws me off.
I chase two more steps.
I run into a post.
I stop and pant.
It's got a long way off.
I look the way it went.
Never mind; I can't be bothered.
I pounce and bite its leg.
I claw at it with my little forelimbs.
I twist my neck and flip it over.
It's bigger than me and I go anyway.

lines.zh: 我扑了个空，牙磕在一起。
lines.en: I snap at air and my teeth clack.

lines.zh: 我抬起后腿踹了它一下。
lines.en: I kick out with a hind leg.

lines.zh: 我低头一撞，角顶上去了。
lines.en: I lower my head and drive my horn in.
One swipe puts me down.
I get up and charge again.
I get its ear.
I tear once and back away.

lines.zh: 它跑开，我追两步就停下。
lines.en: It runs; I chase two steps and stop.
I stand there, breathing fast.
It backs off; I stand there panting.

lines.zh: 草叶分开，我探出小脑袋。
lines.en: The grass parts and my little head pops out.
There are other dinosaurs in the pen.
I look this place over.
The grass in the pen is fresh.

lines.zh: 我蹬了蹬腿，先跑一小段。
lines.en: I kick my legs and take a short dash.
My feet land on soft soil.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里挤出一声尖叫。
lines.en: A shrill cry squeezes out of my throat.

lines.zh: 围栏那头立着一个大影子。
lines.en: A huge shadow stands at the far fence.
I move toward the grass.
It's much wider here than in the egg.
I take two mouthfuls first.
I've marked the way back to the nest.
The fence is tall; I can't get out.
I'll just run about in here.

lines.zh: 我在围栏边上跑了个来回。
lines.en: I run one length of the fence and back.
There's a heap of hay under the post.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻另一只的味道。
lines.en: I sniff at another one's scent.

lines.zh: 这里很安全，我看得出来。
lines.en: It's safe here; I can tell.
Fire catches me and I bolt wildly.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下来，摔得发晕。
lines.en: I fall from a height and land dazed.
Water closes over me and I kick hard.
The blast throws me into the fence.

lines.zh: 有根尖东西扎穿了我的小腿。
lines.en: Something sharp punches through my calf.
The light nails me where I stand.
My empty belly won't let my legs move.
At the thunder I press flat to the ground.
The ground is gone and I keep falling.
